name: Arena Python Agent2
install_cmd: find_python() { for cand in /usr/local/bin/python3.11 /usr/local/bin/python3.10 /opt/alt/python311/bin/python3 /opt/alt/python310/bin/python3 /opt/cpanel/ea-python311/root/usr/bin/python3 /usr/bin/python3.11 /usr/bin/python3.10 /usr/bin/python3.9 python3.11 python3.10 python3.9 python3; do if command -v "$cand" >/dev/null 2>&1; then command -v "$cand"; return 0; elif [ -x "$cand" ]; then echo "$cand"; return 0; fi; done; echo "python3"; }; PYBIN=$(find_python); echo "[deploy] Using Python: $PYBIN"; if [ ! -d ".venv" ]; then ($PYBIN -m venv .venv 2>/dev/null || $PYBIN -m venv --without-pip .venv); fi; if [ ! -f ".venv/bin/pip" ]; then (curl -sS https://bootstrap.pypa.io/get-pip.py | .venv/bin/python3 2>/dev/null || wget -qO- https://bootstrap.pypa.io/get-pip.py | .venv/bin/python3 2>/dev/null || true); fi; .venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
